_meta.description: Executable governance rules for DAHAO. Domains inherit these and may add domain-specific rules.
_meta.note: Rules reference terms via 'uses_terms' and principles via 'implements_principles'.

@rule_proposal_process.description: The required lifecycle for any change to a DAHAO instance.
@rule_proposal_process.logic: ALL proposals MUST follow: DISCUSSION → VOTING → DECISION

requirements: Must include: summary, current state, proposed change, evidence, alignment check

voting.starts: After discussion minimum AND synthesis reached

decision.auto_reject: IF consensus < threshold OR quorum_not_met OR alignment_conflict

@rule_consensus_threshold.description: Required agreement levels for different types of changes.
@rule_consensus_threshold.logic: Different change types require different consensus thresholds.

@rule_protection_ratchet.description: Makes removing protections harder than adding them.

@rule_quorum_requirement.logic: IF participation < 30% of active_contributors THEN vote_result = INVALID
@rule_quorum_requirement.active_definition: Contributors with any activity in last 90 days

@rule_version_reference.description: All proposals must reference exact versions being modified.
@rule_version_reference.logic: Proposal MUST include current_version AND proposed_version
@rule_version_reference.rationale: Ensures clarity about what exactly is changing.

@rule_dialectic_format.description: Discussion must follow structured dialectic process.
@rule_dialectic_format.logic: Discussion MUST include thesis AND (antithesis OR explicit_no_objections) AND synthesis
@rule_dialectic_format.completion: Synthesis must address all substantive antitheses before voting

@rule_alignment_check.description: All proposals must be checked against principles before voting.
@rule_alignment_check.logic: IF proposal CONFLICTS with locked_principle THEN status = AUTO_REJECT
checks: Does proposal violate any locked principle?
@rule_alignment_check.executor: LLM alignment checker + human review for edge cases

@rule_reference_validity.description: All references to terms and principles must be valid.
@rule_reference_validity.logic: ALL items in 'uses_terms' MUST exist in terms.json AND ALL items in 'implements_principles' MUST exist in principles.json
@rule_reference_validity.on_violation: Proposal rejected with list of invalid references

@rule_version_bump.description: How version numbers change based on modification type.

logic.MAJOR: IF removal OR fundamental_redefinition THEN major += 1, minor = 0, patch = 0
logic.MINOR: IF addition OR extension THEN minor += 1, patch = 0
logic.PATCH: IF fix OR clarification THEN patch += 1

@rule_domain_inheritance.logic: Domain MUST declare 'inherits: dahao-org/core v{version}' AND MUST NOT violate core locked principles
requirements: May add domain-specific terms, principles, rules
Domain rules may be stricter than core, never looser
@rule_domain_inheritance.validation: Core alignment checked on every domain proposal

@rule_fork_tracking.description: How forks are tracked relative to upstream.
@rule_fork_tracking.logic: Fork SHOULD declare upstream reference for divergence tracking
@rule_fork_tracking.note: Tracking is optional but enables contribution back to upstream.

@rule_contribution_from_fork.description: How forks can propose changes to upstream.
@rule_contribution_from_fork.logic: Fork MAY propose changes to upstream following upstream's @rule_proposal_process
requirements: Proposal must align with upstream's principles (not fork's)
Evidence from fork's experience is valid but weighted as Tier C
Fork maintainer reputation applies to upstream voting
